subject: math
description: Use parallel line angle theorems to find missing angle measures and justify each step with the correct relationship.
learningObjectives: Identify corresponding, alternate interior, alternate exterior, same-side interior, vertical, and linear-pair angle relationships
Use congruent angle relationships to transfer a known measure to another angle
Use supplementary angle relationships to calculate missing measures
Justify each angle-measure step with a named relationship
prerequisites: Name angles from diagrams using correct notation
Identify angle pairs formed by a transversal
Recognize that vertical angles are congruent
Recognize that a linear pair is supplementary
Solve one-step equations involving sums of 180
